title: Resonant Mode Mixing in Anti-de-Sitter Instability
exact_target: Does resonant transfer of energy to shorter scales explain black-hole formation in anti-de Sitter instability?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002150 (OWR-12009-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/37, pp. 2269--2333. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 52.
Bizon--Rostworowski, weak turbulence (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This asks for a mechanism in the source evolution problem. Resonance in a truncated mode system is not by itself proof that a horizon forms in the full field equations.
